@graph.description: Baseline (2024): lecture halls with constant air volume (CAV) systems controlled by volume flow (outdoor air per floor area).

@graph.name: S1 - Classrooms CAV-person
@graph.description: As Scenario 0, but the CAV systems of the classrooms are controlled on the airflow per person.

@graph.name: S2 - Classrooms VAV-person
@graph.description: Variable air volume (VAV) systems in the classrooms modulating the airflow per person on the occupancy schedule, with a minimum flow (0.15 L/s m2) when unoccupied.

@graph.name: S3 - Classrooms +20% capacity
@graph.description: Classroom seating capacity (people per floor area) increased by 20%.

@graph.name: S4 - Classrooms -20% capacity
@graph.description: Classroom seating capacity (people per floor area) reduced by 20%.

@graph.name: S5 - Classrooms fully occupied
@graph.description: Classrooms 100% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

@graph.name: S6 - Classrooms half occupied
@graph.description: Classrooms 50% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

@graph.name: S7 - Classrooms 75% occupied
@graph.description: Classrooms 75% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

@graph.name: S8 - Classrooms 25% occupied
@graph.description: Classrooms 25% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

@graph.name: S9 - Closed offices CAV-volume
@graph.description: Classrooms repurposed as closed offices (0.12 people/m2, 8.1 W/m2 equipment, generic office schedule) with CAV systems controlled by volume flow.

@graph.name: S10 - Closed offices CAV-person
@graph.description: As Scenario 9, with CAV systems controlled on the airflow per person.

@graph.name: S11 - Closed offices VAV-person
@graph.description: As Scenario 9, with VAV systems modulating the airflow per person on the office occupancy schedule (minimum flow when unoccupied).
